process.heading: How it works
process.subtitle: A simple, transparent process from pickup to arrival.
process.step1Description: Prepare your package and make sure it's packaged properly. Measure the exact dimensions.
process.step2Description: Enter the details on our site, pay for shipping, and print the label in a few clicks.
process.step3Description: Our courier picks up the shipment and we get it to the recipient by the shortest route.
